items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The Brent crude oil price affects the costs of land transport.

qualifiers.rationale: Diesel, refined from crude oil, is a major operating cost for road-freight operators. Fuel-surcharge clauses can pass part of a change on to customers.

items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The Brent crude oil price affects the costs of refined petroleum products.

qualifiers.rationale: Crude oil is the principal feedstock for refiners, so crude prices drive their input costs.

items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The Henry Hub natural gas price affects the costs of Lumeric Chemicals.

qualifiers.rationale: Lumeric (fictional) uses natural gas as both a feedstock and a fuel.

items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The jet fuel price affects the costs of air transport.

qualifiers.rationale: Fuel is typically one of the largest operating costs for airlines.

items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The USD/INR exchange rate affects the costs of Aerisca Airways.

qualifiers.rationale: Aircraft leases and maintenance are commonly priced in U.S. dollars, so a weaker rupee raises an Indian airline's costs in rupees.

items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The USD/INR exchange rate affects the costs of Deltrin Refining.

qualifiers.rationale: Deltrin (fictional) imports crude oil priced in U.S. dollars, so a weaker rupee raises its input costs in rupees.

items.label: affects costs of
items.description: The USD/INR exchange rate affects the costs of Skyvara Air.

qualifiers.rationale: Aircraft leases and maintenance are commonly priced in U.S. dollars, so a weaker rupee raises an Indian airline's costs in rupees.

items.label: affects financing costs of
items.description: The RBI policy repo rate affects the financing costs of Gridwell Power.

qualifiers.rationale: Gridwell (fictional) funds long-lived power assets largely with debt, so higher policy rates tend to raise its borrowing and refinancing costs.

items.label: affects financing costs of
items.description: The RBI policy repo rate affects the financing costs of Trakvel Logistics.

qualifiers.rationale: Trakvel (fictional) finances part of its truck fleet with floating-rate loans that reprice as lending rates respond to policy.

items.label: affects financing costs of
items.description: The U.S. federal funds rate affects the financing costs of Lumeric Chemicals.

qualifiers.rationale: Lumeric (fictional) carries some floating-rate debt linked to U.S. short-term interest rates.

items.label: affects revenue of
items.description: The Brent crude oil price affects the revenue of crude petroleum & natural gas extraction.

qualifiers.rationale: Upstream producers' realised crude prices are typically linked to international benchmarks such as Brent.

items.label: affects revenue of
items.description: The Henry Hub natural gas price affects the revenue of Tessaline Energy.

qualifiers.rationale: Tessaline (fictional) sells natural gas produced in the United States, where Henry Hub is the main pricing benchmark.

items.label: affects revenue of
items.description: The jet fuel price affects the revenue of refined petroleum products.

qualifiers.rationale: Jet fuel is one of the products refiners sell. Higher product prices raise refiners' revenue, although their margins also depend on crude costs.

items.label: affects revenue of
items.description: The RBI policy repo rate affects the revenue of Anvaya Bank.

qualifiers.rationale: Policy rate changes reprice a bank's loans and deposits at different speeds, so the net effect on interest income and margins depends on the bank's balance-sheet structure.

items.label: affects revenue of
items.description: The U.S. federal funds rate affects the revenue of Brookvane Bank.

qualifiers.rationale: Policy rate changes reprice a bank's loans and deposits at different speeds, so the net effect on interest income and margins depends on the bank's balance-sheet structure.

items.label: affects revenue of
items.description: The USD/INR exchange rate affects the revenue of Kovalent Digital.

qualifiers.rationale: Kovalent (fictional) bills most clients in U.S. dollars, so a weaker rupee raises its revenue when reported in rupees. Currency hedging would dampen the effect.

items.label: competes with
items.description: Aerisca Airways and Skyvara Air compete with each other.

qualifiers.rationale: Both fictional airlines operate domestic passenger services in India.

items.label: influences
items.description: The Brent crude oil price influences India CPI inflation.

qualifiers.rationale: India imports most of the crude oil it consumes. Higher crude prices can raise domestic fuel and transport costs and feed into consumer prices, although taxes, administered pricing and CPI basket weights moderate the pass-through.

items.label: influences
items.description: The Brent crude oil price influences the jet fuel price.

qualifiers.rationale: Jet fuel is refined from crude oil, so benchmark jet fuel prices generally move with crude prices. Refining margins (the crack spread) cause the two to diverge at times.

items.label: influences
items.description: India CPI inflation influences the RBI policy repo rate.

qualifiers.rationale: The RBI's monetary policy framework targets CPI inflation, so persistently higher inflation raises the likelihood of a higher policy rate. Policy decisions also weigh growth and financial conditions.

items.label: influences
items.description: The U.S. federal funds rate influences the USD/INR exchange rate.

qualifiers.rationale: Higher U.S. policy rates can strengthen the dollar and draw portfolio capital away from emerging markets, adding depreciation pressure on the rupee. The link is unstable and often dominated by other factors, hence 'weak'.

items.label: influences
items.description: The USD/INR exchange rate influences India CPI inflation.

qualifiers.rationale: A weaker rupee (more rupees per dollar) raises the rupee cost of imports, including crude oil, which can pass through to consumer prices over time.

items.label: is a related measure of
items.description: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %) — India is a related measure of India CPI inflation.

qualifiers.stated_difference: An annual counterpart of this variable, not the same measure: the World Bank series is the change in the annual average consumer price index, while the variable is defined as monthly year-on-year CPI inflation (MoSPI). Use it for long-run context, not as a monthly reading.

items.label: is a related measure of
items.description: Official exchange rate (INR per US$, period average) — India is a related measure of USD/INR exchange rate.

qualifiers.stated_difference: An annual average of the official exchange rate, not the same measure: the variable is defined as a daily market rate. Annual averages smooth out movements within the year.
